caption: The drawing features a repeating pattern set against a dark background, decorated with large, detailed floral designs comprised of red, pink, yellow, and orange flowers with green leaves. Among the flowers, there are several human figures depicted in military-style uniforms in khaki green. Some figures are standing on a rectangular platform or pedestal, others are standing beside or near the platform, and a group of four figures is seen lying together on a tank or armored vehicle also rendered in green tones. Small clusters of red berries appear throughout the black background alongside the flowers and leaves. The overall composition interweaves the human figures and military hardware among the abundance of floral elements, creating a dense and layered appearance. The edges of the image show a slightly frayed border, and the drawing is executed on a rectangular piece of paper with a signature on the bottom right corner.
title: Printed Cotton (Winter Sports)
